lines.en: label rinfirsthall:
scene rinhall1
: Hey, Rin. What’s up?
lines.zh: : 嘿，Rin。怎么了？

lines.en: : {i}Ahem.{/i}
: Hey, Rin. What's up?
lines.zh: : 嘿，Rin。怎么了？

lines.en: : Wow, look at all of this free hair dye and assorted skull accessories.
lines.zh: : 哇，看看这些免费的染发剂和各式各样的骷髅配饰。

lines.en: scene rinhall2
: Huh? What? Hair dye? Where?
lines.zh: : 哈？什么？染发剂？在哪儿？

lines.en: : I'm sorry to disappoint you but there's no free stuff. I just didn't know what else to say to get your attention.
lines.zh: : 很抱歉让你失望了，这里没有免费的东西。我只是不知道还能说什么才能引起你的注意。

lines.en: scene rinhall3
: Oh! Yeah...sorry about that. I didn’t realize you were there and must've...zoned out or something.
lines.zh: : 哦！对……抱歉。我没注意到你在，一定是……走神了什么的。

lines.en: : It’s fine, don't worry about it. What were you looking at, though?
lines.zh: : 没事，别在意。不过你刚才在看什么？

lines.en: scene rinhall4
: Hm? What do you mean?
lines.zh: : 嗯？你什么意思？

lines.en: : You just seemed pretty focused on something while you were ignoring my existence.
lines.zh: : 你无视我存在的时候，看起来挺专注的。

lines.en: scene rinhall5
: Me? Nooo...That doesn't sound like me at all.
lines.zh: : 我？没有啦……听起来一点都不像我。

lines.en: : I was probably just...thinking about how...awesome it is that my teacher is always keeping such a close eye on me!
lines.zh: : 我大概只是在想……我的老师总是这么密切地关注着我，这是多么了不起的一件事啊！

lines.en: scene rinhall6
: You must really care about my future, huh?
lines.zh: : 你一定很在乎我的未来吧？

lines.en: : I don't...{i}not{/i} care about your future?
lines.zh: : 我……也{i}不{/i}是不在乎你的未来？

lines.en: : Cool! But now that we're done talking about me, what are you doing over here?
lines.zh: : 酷！不过我的事聊完了，你在这儿干什么呢？

lines.en: : Apart from closely monitoring my well being, I mean.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是，除了密切监视我过得好不好之外。

lines.en: : Just trying to kill some time. Figured I’d drop by, say hello, and snap you out of whatever sort of trance you were caught in.
lines.zh: : 只是想打发时间。想着顺路过来打个招呼，顺便把你从某种出神状态里拽出来。

lines.en: scene rinhall7
: Well...hello, then!
lines.zh: : 那么……你好呀！

lines.en: : I’d offer to let you in so we can chill in my room, but I’m kinda locked out right now so I guess we're both SOL.
lines.zh: : 我倒是想让你进来，我们可以待在我的房间里，可我现在被锁在门外了，所以我看我们俩都只能认栽了。

lines.en: : You locked yourself out of your own room? How did you manage to pull that off?
lines.zh: : 你把自己锁在自己的房间外面？你是怎么做到的？

lines.en: scene rinhall6
: To be fair, my problem could easily be solved by just going back to school, but...I think I'm having more fun just hanging out in the hallway.
lines.zh: : 说句公道话，只要回学校去，我的问题很容易就能解决，可是……我觉得就这么在走廊里待着反而更有趣。

lines.en: : Yeah, you seemed to be having a real blast before I showed up.
lines.zh: : 是啊，在我来之前你看起来确实玩得挺开心的。

lines.en: : Maybe staring off into space is one of my hobbies? You don't see me belittling you for spending your free time sneaking into girls' dorms.
lines.zh: : 也许发呆是我的爱好之一？我可没因为你在空余时间溜进女生宿舍就贬低你。

lines.en: : I'll have you know that security is essentially non-existent here and that I was able to get inside with virtually no sneaking whatsoever.
lines.zh: : 我得让你知道，这里的安保基本上形同虚设，我几乎没怎么“溜”就进来了。

lines.en: : Well, I sure hope security for the shower room is a little bit tighter!
lines.zh: : 那我倒真希望淋浴室那边的安保能严一点！

lines.en: : If you really need your keys, I can walk with you back to school. It's not like I have anything else going on right now.
lines.zh: : 如果你真的需要钥匙，我可以陪你走回学校。反正我现在也没别的事。

lines.en: scene rinhall8
: Nah, it's fine. The gates are probably locked by now anyway and I don't wanna have to make you hop them with me.
lines.zh: : 不用啦，没关系的。校门大概也已经锁了，而且我不想拖着你跟我一起翻墙。

lines.en: : Unless you've got a key, of course. But you don't really look like the type of guy the school would trust a key with.
lines.zh: : 当然，除非你有钥匙。不过你看起来也不像是学校会放心把钥匙交给他的人。

lines.en: : I feel like I'm supposed to be offended by this but, to be honest, I don't really feel anything.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我理应被这话冒犯到，但说实话，我什么感觉都没有。

lines.en: scene rinhall8r
: Mood.
: Thanks for offering, though, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 不过还是谢谢你提出来，Sensei。

lines.en: : If Futaba wasn't already on her way back, I'd probably take you up on your offer. Quickest way to solve this remains to be just...sitting around and waiting.
lines.zh: : 如果 Futaba 不是已经在回来的路上，我大概就接受你的提议了。最快的解决办法依然只是……坐在这儿等着。

lines.en: scene rinhall7
: Just wish there was a little more to actually {i}do{/i} in the hallway, though. Options are {i}pretty{/i} limited here, as I'm sure you've noticed.
lines.zh: : 只是希望走廊里能多点事{i}做{/i}。这里的选项{i}相当{/i}有限，你肯定也注意到了。

lines.en: : You could always talk to Chika. She’s standing right there.
lines.zh: : 你大可以去找 Chika 聊天。她就站在那儿呢。

lines.en: scene rinhall9
: Ooooooh...woooooow! It appears she is!
lines.zh: : 噢——哦——哇！看来她确实在！

lines.en: : And to think that I am just noticing that for the first time right now...
lines.zh: : 真没想到我居然是第一次注意到这件事……

lines.en: : You're acting weird.
lines.zh: : 你很奇怪。

lines.en: scene rinhall10
: No! {i}You're{/i} acting weird! I'm acting like a completely normal teenage girl who just happens to enjoy yelling during her free time!
lines.zh: : 才不！{i}你{/i}才奇怪！我表现得完全就是一个普普通通的少女，只不过恰好喜欢在空闲时间大喊大叫而已！

lines.en: : Do you...want {i}me{/i} to invite Chika to join us?
lines.zh: : 你……想让{i}我{/i}叫 Chika 一起来吗？

lines.en: scene rinhall2
: What? No. Chika's always just...
lines.zh: : 什么？不。Chika 一直就是……

lines.en: scene rinhall10r
: Chika's always just on her phone and stuff...
lines.zh: : Chika 一直就是抱着手机什么的……

lines.en: : We'd probably be better off if we just, like...left her alone or-
lines.zh: : 我们大概还是……别去打扰她比较好，或者——

lines.en: scene rinhall10r2
: Ah- I think that's Futaba.
lines.zh: : 啊——我觉得那是 Futaba。

lines.en: : Almost back with your key to salvation?
lines.zh: : 快带着拯救你的钥匙回来了？

lines.en: : No, just the key to our room.
lines.zh: : 不，只是我们房间的钥匙。

lines.en: : Either that or she's about to be eaten by wolves and is simply saying goodbye and thanks for everything.
lines.zh: : 要么就是她快要被狼吃掉了，正在跟所有人道别、感谢这一切。

lines.en: : For everyone's sake, I'm going to hope it's the former.
lines.zh: : 为了所有人着想，我希望是前者。

lines.en: scene rinhall3
: Same. You should probably head out now, though. I don't want Futaba getting jealous thinking that I'm out here trying to cozy up to you when {i}you're{/i} the one stalking {i}me.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我也是。不过你现在大概该走了。我可不想让 Futaba 以为我在这儿跟你套近乎而吃醋——明明跟踪{i}我{/i}的人是{i}你{/i}。

lines.en: : I can assure you that I am very much not stalking you, nor do I ever intend to.
lines.zh: : 我可以向你保证，我绝对没有跟踪你，也从不打算这么做。

lines.en: scene rinhall2
: Not even a little? That's actually kind of offensive.
lines.zh: : 一点都没有？这话说出来还挺伤人的。

lines.en: : I am hurt and appalled and think you should at least {i}think{/i} about stalking me occasionally.
lines.zh: : 我很受伤，也很震惊，我觉得你至少该{i}考虑{/i}偶尔跟踪我一下。

lines.en: : I will...add it to my list of things to do. Later, Rin.
lines.zh: : 我会……把它加进我的待办清单里。回头见，Rin。

lines.en: scene rinhall6
: Later, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 回头见，Sensei。

lines.en: : Bring popcorn next time, okay?
lines.zh: : 下次记得带爆米花，好吗？

lines.en: scene black
I exit the dorm and make my way back into the street without any interest in ever purchasing Rin popcorn.
lines.zh: 我走出宿舍回到街上，完全没有兴趣去给 Rin 买爆米花。

lines.en: What I {i}do{/i} have an interest in, though...is why she got so weird as soon as I mentioned Chika.
lines.zh: 我{i}倒是{/i}有点兴趣的是……为什么我一提到 Chika，她就变得那么奇怪。

lines.en: Granted, she was already weird before that, but...
lines.zh: 当然，在那之前她就已经很奇怪了，可是……

lines.en: I can't help but feel like there might be a little more to her lurking somewhere beneath the surface.
lines.zh: 我忍不住觉得，在她表面的下面，可能还藏着更多的东西。

lines.en: $ rinfirsthall = True
$ rin_love += 1
{i}Rin’s affection has increased to [rin_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Rin 的好感度提升到了 [rin_love]!{/i}
